mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT failure_count FROM login_failure_counters WHERE username_normalized=#{username}),0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_failure_counters(username_normalized,failure_count) VALUES(#{username},1) ON CONFLICT(username_normalized) DO UPDATE SET failure_count=login_failure_counters.failure_count+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT answer_hash FROM login_captcha_challenges WHERE id=#{id} AND username_normalized=#{username} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE login_captcha_challenges SET used_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
